content:
sarah: kicking off release/2026.03 now. Plan: enable ff-vec-search at 0.5% -> 5% -> 50% in 30m windows. monitoring: latency, 5xx, precision. @matt can you watch oncall dashboards? :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deploy started for release/2026.03 on prod (uid: dpl_9876). Rolling service grp: search-api. ETA ~10m.

matt: on it. will watch error budget and traces. alert thresholds pinned in runbook.

julie: FYI product approved ramp plan. If we see quality regressions we should pin to previous model.

raj: toggles ready. snippet:
```
flags:
  ff-vec-search:
    rollout: 0.005
    schedule: [30m, 30m]
    metrics: [latency_p95, 5xx_rate]
```

sarah: enabling at 0.5% now.

deploy-bot: Feature flag ff-vec-search set to 0.5% for release/2026.03 by sarah.

matt: seeing slight p95 bump ~70ms -> 95ms at 2m, 5xx steady. marking :eyes:

julie: tracked a decrease in relevance on eval-set A (n=200). delta -2.1% precision. putting a hold on next ramp until we correlate.

sarah: paused ramp, setting flag back to 0.0 while we triage. @raj can you pin model to canary variant and collect traces? :warning:

raj: pinned model to canary-v2 for traffic with ff toggles. traces collected. debug logs at /s3/debug/release-2026-03/trace.tar.gz

deploy-bot: Feature flag ff-vec-search set to 0.0 by sarah.

matt: error budget ok, but precision delta concerning. rolling back to previous embedding config in configstore: emb-config:v42

sarah: rolling back config and re-running tests. will update release notes and open a short post-deploy incident if needed.

julie: noted. can we schedule a follow-up evallist for tomorrow AM? I'll own.

sarah: yes. for now release marked 'degraded; gated'. Will not proceed with further ramps until investigation complete. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished with status: partial (flags gated). release/2026.03 state=GATED. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-007
